title: 'Backglow' Lets You Customize New MacBook Pro's Glowing Apple Logo
snippet: A new "Backglow" app created by designer Juan Buis lets you customize the illuminated Apple logo on the lid of the new MacBook Pro models. The free version of the app allows you to manually adjust the brightness level of the Apple logo, independent of the MacBook Pro's display brightness level. You can also turn it off entirely with a single click, rather than having to use Terminal. Another free option is a "Breathe" mode that makes the logo's light gently pulse similarly to the sleep indicator
